title: 11 Best Cafes & Coffee Shops Near Mangwon Market
description: The best cafes, coffee shops, bakeries, and dessert spots near Mangwon Market in Seoul — curated from Reddit and local blogs.

picks.name: Anthracite Coffee Seogyo (앤트러사이트 서교)
picks.insiderTip: A converted warehouse turned silent coffee sanctuary — Mangwon's most atmospheric cafe and one of Seoul's best roasters.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature pour-over using house-roasted single-origin beans. The flat white is also exceptional. No music plays — just the sound of coffee being made.

picks.name: Deep Blue Lake Coffee (딥블루레이크)
picks.insiderTip: The striking blue three-story roastery right outside Mangwon Market — perfect for an Australian-style flat white after exploring the stalls.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Nordic-style specialty flat white or a clean pour-over. The beans are roasted in-house on the first floor.

picks.name: Gelateria Dangdo (당도)
picks.insiderTip: Mangwon's best gelato — inventive Korean-inspired flavors like matcha cherry and seasonal bingsu that rival anything in Gangnam.
picks.whatToOrder: The matcha cherry gelato is a crowd favorite. In summer, don't miss the tomato bingsu or Tokyo bingsu — seasonal specials that sell out fast.

picks.name: Mangwondong Tiramisu (망원동티라미수)
picks.insiderTip: THE tiramisu destination of Mangwon-dong — every variation from classic to Oreo, perfect for a Han River picnic.
picks.whatToOrder: Try the original tiramisu first, then branch out to Oreo or seasonal flavors. Take-out portions are perfect for picnicking at Mangwon Hangang Park.

picks.name: eert Mangwon
picks.insiderTip: A stunning tea house built from a stripped-back old building — watch tea masters work on the first floor, then retreat upstairs to sip in peace.
picks.whatToOrder: Watch the tea masters on the first floor prepare your drink — their specialty teas are crafted with ceremony. The atmosphere alone is worth the visit.

picks.name: Uig (우이그)
picks.insiderTip: Scotland meets Mangwon — wood tones and exposed concrete inspired by the Isle of Uig, with handmade tigre cakes and cranachan you won't find anywhere else in Seoul.
picks.whatToOrder: The handmade tigre cakes are their signature. Also try the cranachan — a Scottish cream dessert that's a rare find in Korea.

picks.name: Huwa Huwa (후와후와)
picks.insiderTip: Known as the 'master of salt bread' in Mangwon — expect weekend lines for their pistachio chestnut sandwich and strawberry sandwich.
picks.whatToOrder: The salt bread is legendary. The pistachio chestnut sandwich and strawberry sandwich are crowd favorites — get there early on weekends to beat the line.

picks.name: Petrol Place (페트롤플레이스)
picks.insiderTip: A beautifully designed neighborhood cafe with wooden walls and symmetrical lines — the perfect late-night escape with coffee and cake until midnight.
picks.whatToOrder: Their lovingly made coffee drinks and seasonal cakes. The space itself — bottles, glasses, wooden accents — is half the experience.

picks.name: KETOBBANG (키토빵앗간)
picks.insiderTip: Seoul's best keto-friendly bakery — a local's secret for guilt-free pastries near Mangwon Market.
picks.whatToOrder: Their keto bread and pastries are made fresh daily. Popular with health-conscious locals — a rare find in Seoul's bakery scene.

picks.name: Kindly Coffee & Dessert (카인들리)
picks.insiderTip: A warm-toned neighborhood gem near Mangwon Station with beautiful natural lighting — the kind of cozy cafe you'll want to return to.
picks.whatToOrder: Their coffee and dessert pairings are thoughtfully crafted. The warm, natural-lit interior makes everything taste better.

picks.name: Bowly
picks.insiderTip: A neat little Mangwon spot for healthy brunch bowls, fresh juices, and good coffee — the perfect light meal before or after the market.
picks.whatToOrder: The yogurt bowl is the star — fresh, creamy, and beautifully presented. Pair it with a fresh juice or coffee.
